concept.title: Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control pause/driver operation

conbody.p: If Smart Cruise Control cannot be operated due to pause or rerouting, the gray () indicator will appear on the cluster.
If the accelerator pedal is depressed, the white () indicator will blink on the cluster.

note.p: The warning message will appear in the following circumstances:

li.p: Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control is not able to slow down your vehicle to a safe speed

note.p: The images and colors in the instrument cluster may differ depending on the cluster type or theme selected from the settings menu.
